Appetisers.name: Paw Pia Tod / Vegetable Spring Rolls

Appetisers.name: Na Moo / Toasted Pork Triangles

Appetisers.name: Goong Tempura / Tempura King Prawns Starter

Appetisers.name: Hedt Gatium / Garlic Scallops
Appetisers.description: King scallops in a smooth Thai garlic butter sauce

Appetisers.name: King Prawn and Pork Parcels
Appetisers.description: Lek's own creation of pork & Thai herbs in a crispy shell Served with Thai Plum Sauce

Appetisers.name: Crispy Pork Envelopes
Appetisers.description: Pork & herbs folded in a light pastry triangle. Served with Thai Plum Sauce

Appetisers.name: Pak Tempura / Tempura Vegetables
Appetisers.description: Tasty fresh vegetables dipped and fried in our light and crispy oriental tempura batter. Served with Sweet Chilli Sauce

Appetisers.name: Gai Tempura / Tempura Chicken
Appetisers.description: Chicken breast slices dipped and fried in our light and crispy oriental tempura batter. Served with Sweet Chilli Sauce

Appetisers.name: Tom Yum / Hot and Sour Soup
Mixed Platter
Appetisers.description: Spring rolls, chicken satay, toasted pork triangles and tempura vegetables. Minimum two people.

Seafood.name: Talay Woonsen / Seafood Noodles
Seafood.description: The best the sea has to offer all in one great dish; A heavenly medley of seafood; squid, prawns, mussels & tasty vermicelli Woon Sen noodle and fresh vegetables

Seafood.name: Muk Gatiem / Garlic Squid Rings
Seafood.description: This delicious seafood dish showcases crispy and tender squid rings stir-fried with garlic and a blend of herbs and spices to create a savory and aromatic experience. The garlic flavor is pronounced, depth to the dish, while the blend of herbs and spices complement the natural sweetness of the squid.

Seafood.name: Goong Chup Pang Tod / Tempura King Prawns
Seafood.description: A deliciously crispy and succulent treat that showcases the fresh and natural flavour of plump king prawns. Our tempura King Prawns are lightly battered and fried to golden perfection, giving you the perfect balance of crunch and tenderness in every bite. Served with Sweet Chilli Sauce

Seafood.name: Goong Gatium / Garlic Butter King Prawns
Seafood.description: Juicy king prawns marinated in garlic, herbs and soy sauce, pan-fried to perfection on skewers. Enjoy the delicate sweetness and rich umami flavours for a satisfying choice for seafood lovers.

Seafood.name: Goong Pao / Grilled Prawns
Seafood.description: Chargrilled butterfly king prawns, dressed in a powerful garlic sauce. This dish is best as finger food and the sweet chilli sauce adds a pack of flavour to this house favourite. Served with Sweet Chilli Sauce

Seafood.name: Pla Rad Prik / Seabass in Penang Sauce
Seafood.description: Delight in the tender seabass fillet, fried to golden perfection and dressed in a rich and flavourful Penang sauce. The creamy curry combines coconut milk, spices, and aromatics such as lemongrass, garlic, and ginger for a burst of authentic Thai flavours. A must-try for anyone who loves fish and exotic cuisine.

Stirfry.name: Pad Prik / Chilli Stirfry
Stirfry.description: A great fresh taste that comes straight from the chillies! Your choice of meat, delicately stir fried with fresh chillies and our full selection of fresh vegetables such as sugar snaps, onions & chestnut mushrooms

Stirfry.name: Pad Nam Man Hoi / Oyster Sauce
Stirfry.description: Stir fried chestnut mushrooms, onions & fresh vegetables seasoned in a rich oyster sauce.

Stirfry.name: Pad Kratiem / Garlic
Stirfry.description: Fresh garlic fried & mixed with butter, soya sauce & seasoning.

Stirfry.name: Pad Med Mamuang / Cashew Nuts
Stirfry.description: Famous Thai stir fry with onion, carrots, mushroom, bell peppers, & in house, dry roasted cashew nuts!

Stirfry.name: Pad Ka Pow / Sweet Basil
Stirfry.description: A very spicy blend of Thai sweet basil, garlic & fresh red chillies mixed in Lek’s own delicate sweet basil Thai sauce.

Stirfry.name: Pad Prik Khing / Crispy Sweet Chili
Stirfry.description: Our Thai sweet chilli sauce with a selection of seasonal fresh vegetables such as sweet peppers, celery and mushrooms.

Stirfry.name: Pad Priaw Waan / Sweet and Sour
Stirfry.description: A super sticky dish made by us using our secret home recipe with sweet oranges & oriental rice vinegar flavours

Noodles.name: Pad Thai / Rice Noodles
Noodles.description: Our South Thai take on a national dish. Flat rice noodles and a selection of fresh vegetables in a sticky tamarind citrus sauce

Noodles.name: Pad Mee Leuang / Yellow Noodles
Noodles.description: The “classic noodle”`. These noodles are made with wheat flour and are soft & tasty. These noodles are stir fried with chestnut mushrooms, onions & other fresh vegetables

Noodles.name: Pad Woon Sen / Glass Noodles
Noodles.description: This delightful dish uses thin glass noodles made from mung bean starch. These noodles are cooked with soy sauce, oyster sauce and a selection of fresh vegetables

Noodles.name: Pad Kee Mao / Drunken Noodles
Noodles.description: Infused with fragrant Thai basil and chilies, we use yellow noodles to hold the classic Thai flavours, its nice and spicy, perfect for adventurous eaters seeking a taste of Thailand!

Curry.name: Gaeng Keow Wan / Green Curry
Curry.description: Characterized by its bright green color and spicy flavor. Green curry is made with a young green birds eye chillis which adds a sharper, snappier, more biting heat to them. This dish is enjoyed for its bold taste and versatility. Cooked with a range of fresh vegetables and bamboo strips.

Curry.name: Gaeng Daeng / Red Curry
Curry.description: Known for its vibrant red colour and spicy flavour, Red curry uses fully ripened red birds eye chillies that have a mellower, more lasting heat to them and for most this makes this a spicier experience than green curry.

Curry.name: Gaeng Penang
Curry.description: A creamy curry full of the bold flavours of Lemongrass, Galangal, Kaffir Limes, Coriander seeds, Cumin, Pepper and Mungbean. This has a nice twist from Leks South Thai influence and is spicier than most

Curry.name: Gaeng Mussaman
Curry.description: Unique to the Southern regions of Thailand and Lek's speciality. Slightly savoury, mild and nutty!

Curry.name: 13d. Gaeng Ped Yang / Duck Curry
Curry.description: Twist up your red curry with duck breast and pineapple, the best way to enjoy curry. Red curry uses fully ripened red birds eye chilli's that have a mellower, more lasting heat to them, the pineapple adds a nice sourness to balance the heat The perfect accompaniment to this dish is Special Fried Rice

Khao Pad.name: Khao Pad Pak (Vegetables)
Khao Pad.description: Jasmine rice fried with generous helpings of finely chopped vegetables with an egg scrambled throughout

Khao Pad.name: Khao Pad Saphorat (Pineapple)
Khao Pad.description: Jasmine rice fried with finely chopped vegetables, pineapple with egg scrambled throughout

Khao Pad.name: Khao Pad Gai (Chicken)
Khao Pad.description: Jasmine rice fried with thinly sliced chicken breast with egg scrambled throughout

Khao Pad.name: Khao Pad Moo (Pork)
Khao Pad.description: Jasmine rice fried with finely chopped vegetables, thinly sliced pork leg with egg scrambled throughout

Khao Pad.name: Khao Pad Neua Pu (Crab)
Khao Pad.description: Jasmine rice fried with finely chopped vegetables, crab meat with egg scrambled throughout

Khao Pad.name: Khao Pad Goong (King Prawns)
Khao Pad.description: Jasmine rice fried with finely chopped vegetables, King Prawns with egg scrambled throughout

Khao Pad.name: Khao Pad Rhom Mit (Seafood)
Khao Pad.description: A selection of your seafood favourites make this the tastiest of them all, King Prawns, Squid, Crab Meat, Mussels and Scallops are stir fried with finely chopped vegetables and finished with an egg scrambled throughout

House Specials.name: Yum / Spicy Thai Salad
House Specials.description: A spicy & sweet mix of lime juice, garlic, fresh Thai birds eye chillies & green salad. A VERY hot dish but very refreshing! Great for hot summer days. The perfect accompaniment to this dish is Sticky Rice

House Specials.name: Laab / Spicy Pork Mince
House Specials.description: Popular spicy salad from Northeast Thailand made with birds eye chillies, shallots, lime juice & seasoned minced pork. The perfect accompaniment to this dish is Sticky Rice

House Specials.name: Som Tam / Papaya Salad
House Specials.description: Thailand's favourite spicy salad, made with fresh, crunchy green papaya, birds eye chilli, tomatoes & peanuts. The perfect accompaniment to this dish is Sticky Rice

Rice and Sides.name: Special Fried Rice
Rice and Sides.description: Chicken, Beef, Pork, Prawn, Egg and Thai Seasoning

Rice and Sides.name: Extra Prawn Crackers
Rice and Sides.description: For ordering direct, you get one bowl free but you're welcome to order extra!

pricing_notes: One eligible main + jasmine rice + one Chang for £20.
